What's your warranty policy on defective items?
Our warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal household use. The coverage period depends on the item and purchase date:



Warmers purchased before March 20, 2026: one year from purchase.


Warmers purchased on or after March 20, 2026: six months from purchase. You can register your warmer within 60 days of purchase for a free two-year limited warranty.


Warmer lightbulbs: 90 days from purchase.


Silicone dishes: six months from purchase.



During the initial warranty period, the manufacturer replaces products or parts affected by manufacturing defects at no charge. During the extended limited warranty period, replacements are offered at a 50% discount. The warranty doesn’t cover accidental damage, abuse, neglect, incorrect voltage or power supply, attempted repair, or loss or theft.
You can read the full details on our Shipping, Warranty, & Returns page. If you tell me which item is defective and when you bought it, I can help narrow down which coverage applies.
